pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantā lābhino honti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.3: atha kho chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.4: etarahi kho āvuso therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadantā lābhino honti cīvara- parikkhārānaṃ .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.6: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ: amhe pi bhaginiyo upasaṃkamatha, mayam pi ovadissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.7: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo yena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.8: upasaṃkamitvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.9: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīnaṃ parittañ ñeva dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā divasaṃ tiracchānakathāya vītināmetvā uyyojesuṃ gacchatha bhaginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.10: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavā etad avoca: kacci bhikkhuniyo ovādo iddho ahosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.12: ayyā chabbaggiyā parittañ ñeva . . . uyyojesun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.13: atha kho bhagavā tā bhikkhuniyo dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.14: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā . . . sampahaṃsitā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.15: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā chabbaggiye bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.16: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ parittañ ñeva . . . uyyojethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.19: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunīnaṃ parittañ ñeva . . . uyyojessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.20: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.26: yācitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.28: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.32: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno bhikkhunovādakassa sammuti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.42: atha kho bhagavā chabbaggiye bhikkhū anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.43: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.44.1: yo pana bhikkhu asammato bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:1.45: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.1: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū sammatā bhikkhuniyo ovadantā tath' eva lābhino honti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.2: atha kho chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.3: etarahi kho āvuso therā bhikkhū sammatā bhikkhuniyo ovadantā tath' eva lābhino honti cīvara- parikkhārānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.4: handāvuso mayam pi nissīmaṃ gantvā aññamaññaṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ sammannitvā bhikkhuniyo ovadāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.5: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nissīmaṃ gantvā aññ. bh. samm. bhikkhuniyo upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ: mayam pi bhaginiyo sammatā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.6: amhe pi upasaṃkamatha, mayam pi ovadissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.26: anujānāmi bhikkhave aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ sammannituṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.27: sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.28: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūp' assa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.29: ubhayāni kho pan' assa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.33: na kho pan' etaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajitāya kāsāyavatthavasanāya garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannapubbo hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:2.35: anujānāmi bhikkhave imehi aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhunovādakaṃ sammannitun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.13: tena sammatena bhikkhunā pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā āsanaṃ paññāpetvā dutiyaṃ gahetvā nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.14: bhikkhunīhi tattha gantvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.17: sace samagga 'mhāyyā 'ti bhaṇanti, vattanti bhaginiyo aṭṭha garudhammā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.18: sace vattant' ayyā 'ti bhaṇanti eso bhaginiyo ovādo 'ti niyyādetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.19: sace na vattant' ayyā 'ti bhaṇanti, osāretabbā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.20: vassasatupasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahupasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ kātabbaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.21: ayam pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.22: na bhikkhuniyā abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ vasitabbaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.24: anvaddhamāsaṃ bhikkhuniyā bhikkhusaṃghato dve dhammā paccāsiṃsitabbā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.27: vassaṃ vutthāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṃghe tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.28: diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vā;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.30: garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannāya bhikkhuniyā ubhatosaṃghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.32: dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya ubhatosaṃghe upasampadā pariyesitabbā;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.34: na bhikkhuniyā kenaci pariyāyena bhikkhu akkositabbo paribhāsitabbo;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.36: ajjatagge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.38: sace samagga 'mhāyyā 'ti bhaṇantaṃ aññaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.39: sace vagga 'mhāyyā 'ti bhaṇantaṃ aṭṭha garudhamme bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.1.40: ovādaṃ aniyyādetvā aññaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.2.1: adhammakamme adhammakammasaññī vaggaṃ bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ vaggasaññī ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.2.2: adhammakamme adhammakammasaññī vaggaṃ bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ vematiko ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.2.3: adh. adh. v. bh. samaggasaññī ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc21:3.2.4: adhammakamme vematiko vaggaṃ bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ vaggasaññī ovadati . . .
